# results

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-bots/internal/results"
```

Package results reads test results and assigns them to test files.

Two sources are read: the event stream of \`go test \-json\`, and Ginkgo's JSON report \(\-ginkgo.json\-report\). A Go test belongs to the file that declares its function; a Ginkgo spec belongs to the file of its It. A package that failed to build gives every test file in it a failed "\(build\)" result.

<a name="FileResults"></a>
## type FileResults

FileResults are the results of one test file.

```go
type FileResults struct {
    File    discover.File
    Results []Result
}
```

<a name="FileResults.Counts"></a>
### func \(FileResults\) Counts

```go
func (f FileResults) Counts() (passed, failed, skipped int)
```

Counts returns how many results passed, failed and were skipped.

<a name="Result"></a>
## type Result

Result is one test's result.

```go
type Result struct {
    // Name is the Go test function, or a Ginkgo spec's container texts and
    // leaf text joined with " / ".
    Name     string
    Outcome  Outcome
    Duration time.Duration
    // Output is the test's output (Go) or failure or skip message (Ginkgo),
    // kept for failed and skipped tests only.
    Output string
}
```

<a name="Run.AddGinkgoJSON"></a>
### func \(\*Run\) AddGinkgoJSON

```go
func (r *Run) AddGinkgoJSON(in io.Reader) error
```

AddGinkgoJSON reads a Ginkgo JSON report. Only It specs are kept; suite setup nodes such as BeforeSuite fail their suite's Go test, which the \`go test \-json\` stream already reports.

<a name="Run.AddGoTestJSON"></a>
### func \(\*Run\) AddGoTestJSON

```go
func (r *Run) AddGoTestJSON(in io.Reader) error
```

AddGoTestJSON reads a \`go test \-json\` stream. Lines that are not JSON \(stderr mixed in by \`2\>&1\`\) are ignored.

<a name="Run.Assign"></a>
### func \(\*Run\) Assign

```go
func (r *Run) Assign(files []discover.File, module, root string) []FileResults
```

Assign groups the run's results by test file. module is the Go module path \(to turn package import paths into directories\) and root the absolute repository root \(to make Ginkgo's file names relative\). Files with no result in the run are left out. Results are in name order.
